scope: Only repeated producer _guard/toolchain measurement/source-capability hashing and directly reached reader/process lifetime. No diagnostics/tests/native/network execution or private/runtime/evidence/process inspection.
conclusion: A concrete plausible cumulative parent-memory mechanism exists: a new ctypes file-information type and pointer type are created on every protected Windows file read, amplified by every frozen-file guard. No attribution of the observed multi-GB host-pressure event is established without measurement.

finding.severity: Important plausible cumulative-memory defect; incident causality unproven
chain: producer._guard lines124-125 reads every frozen source/tool/test input via catalog.read_local on every guard.
catalog.read_local lines37-41 dispatches each Windows read to safe_files._windows_read.
safe_files._windows_read lines36-39 declares a fresh local Information ctypes.Structure class on every call.

Line40 calls ctypes.POINTER(Information); CPython uses its process-global _pointer_type_cache for pointer types. A fresh distinct Structure type produces a fresh cache key/type rather than reusing a bounded ABI type.

Therefore completed local reads can leave their distinct type/pointer descriptors rooted process-wide even after file handles close and file bytes are released. Repeated before/after guards multiply this by the number of guarded files.
finding.primary_runtime_source_context: The local CPython3.12 ctypes/__init__.py exports _pointer_type_cache at255 and its explicit reset path clears that cache at265-274. No runtime cache contents were inspected.
finding.scale: Approximately twice the source-command count in guard calls, multiplied by the frozen-file count, can produce tens or hundreds of thousands of distinct type requests. Per-type retained bytes and actual aggregate RSS are not measured here; no GB estimate is asserted.
finding.minimal_fix_direction: Reuse a single stable fixed-ABI file-information structure/pointer (module-level Windows type or bounded lazy type factory). Keep actual file bytes/metadata/source identities fresh. Do not clear global ctypes caches and do not add a content/stat/PASS cache.
finding.meaningful_owned_regression: In a fresh owned isolated source process, perform repeated actual reads of a fresh nonsecret ordinary file, compare pre/post count of this reader's Information pointer-type entries and actual bytes; count should remain bounded after initialization. Retain existing linked/reparse and metadata/byte integrity refusals. Root can separately measure that isolated process private bytes/RSS/handle count before/after; no unrelated application changes are needed.
finding.adjacent_note: _windows_stage also declares a local Information type, but it is not part of _guard's repeated read chain. A shared ABI type can cover it without changing IO/authority semantics.

bounded_or_short_lived_paths: Toolchain _hash and distribution _hash stream1MiB chunks with context-managed handles, rather than retaining browser/interpreter/package bytes.
Toolchain _inventory builds a local path->digest dictionary and canonical string, returns only a digest; no module-global inventory/content cache or growing list was found.
_source_revision creates local pending/files collections and one fresh file buffer at a time; no cross-call inventory/stat/content cache is present.

build_capability_snapshot builds a finite9-entry snapshot from eight indicators plus grammar. The qualify setup builds measured capability identity once; _guard itself calls fresh source hashes rather than accumulating snapshots.

Toolchain _version TemporaryFile is context-managed and output read is4096bytes. OwnedProcess.wait invokes terminate_owned; timer is cancelled and a successfully reaped Windows Job handle is closed. No success-path unbounded open-file/Job-handle list was found in this chain.
no_claims: The parent-reported memory-pressure failure and post-parent available-memory rebound were not independently observed by this reviewer.
This static mechanism is compatible with cumulative process memory and release at parent exit, but does not establish the cause or amount of the actual host-memory deficit.
No source/native/PQR result or acceptance credit is issued. Any fix changes the source subject and needs its own actual regression and qualification.
